title: Build import candidates in staging before promotion
decision: SG-0007 import refresh should build a candidate epp-full workspace in a non-app-facing staging area, run source-leak and reference-integrity checks against the candidate, and promote imported surfaces into workspaces/epp-full only after checks pass. If candidate import or validation fails, the existing live epp-full workspace remains usable, no success import audit event is appended, and failure details stay in command output.
context: SG-0007 now preserves app-owned state and appends sanitized success events to the audit ledger. Because SG-0013 depends on the cleaned epp-full workspace, failed cleanup must not leave the live workspace half-refreshed.
rationale: A staging-and-promote flow keeps import refresh repeatable while protecting the current app workspace from partial writes, failed cleanup, and misleading audit history.
alternatives_considered: Refresh workspaces/epp-full in place and rely on manual cleanup after failures
Delete and rebuild the live workspace before validation
Append audit failure events even when no workspace mutation was promoted
consequences: The app and local service should not discover or browse staging import candidates as workspaces
Source-leak and reference-integrity checks should run against the staged candidate before promotion
Promotion should replace only imported surfaces and preserve app-owned audit, workbook, draft, and runtime state
A sanitized success audit event should be appended only after successful validation and promotion
Failed candidate imports should produce clear console output without mutating the live workspace or appending a success event
